extracted.name: Ham with Red Eye Gravy
extracted.description: Red-eye gravy is a traditional Southern gravy made with black coffee and roast ham pan drippings for a delicious sweet-smoky flavor combination.
ingredient_lines: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
0.125 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir ham scraps until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove to a plate, reserving the grease in the pan.
Place ham slices in the pan and cook over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes on each side. Season both sides with salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper. Remove ham and reserve on a plate.

Reduce heat to medium-low and sprinkle flour over the pan drippings. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Increase heat to medium-high and pour coffee into the pan. Cook and stir until combined and thickened. Season to taste. Return ham to the pan to warm through.
